goal: 100 percent design-reference fidelity is the user goal, not a passed conclusion or a measured score.

measurement_contract.coordinates: Global source JPEG pixels; (u,v), origin top-left, u right, v down. xyxy bounds are approximate edge coordinates.
measurement_contract.point_method: Manually inspected original and temporary enlarged crops with 20 px grid; no generated redraw or alternative reference.
measurement_contract.pixel_uncertainty: Typically 2-4 px for a clear contour; 5-7 px for partial ring/occlusion. These are visual-selection ranges, not survey confidence intervals.
measurement_contract.profile_semantics: Samples describe visible outlines/color boundaries. An open profile must remain open; closing across occlusion would invent hidden geometry. Closed blue/color patches may be occlusion-truncated visible regions, not complete part silhouettes.
measurement_contract.curve_policy: Retain deliberate sharp ridges/corner breaks; interpolate curved spans with shallow controlled curvature. Shallow bevels and broad multi-facet curved faces must not be replaced by an ellipsoid or universal cylinder.
measurement_contract.material_color_policy: Ivory, vivid azure blue, warm gold/yellow, and layered near-black; no precise material RGB/PBR values are claimed from shaded JPEG pixels.
measurement_contract.joint_policy: Visible bearing cap centers are appearance landmarks. They are not enough to determine physical multi-axis mechanism, axle depth or hidden knee origin.

profiles.comment: Continuous headless chest shield. The narrow bottom belongs to the ivory shield, not a neck or separate helmet. Preserve crown arc, shoulder cutaways and the approximately 25 px bottom width.

A swept shoulder ribbon with a broad rear/top shoulder lip, diagonal ridge and taper to chest. This is not a spherical shoulder cap.
Arc is visible; hidden circle and rear guard thickness are not reconstructed here. Blue outer guard covers the lower outer portion.
Asymmetric open-bottom shoulder armor, with a bright broad facet on the upper/inner face and dark lower mouth.
Tapered angled guard overlaps the dark upper arm. Sloped ends and small yellow marker are part of its identity, not a plain straight tube.
A separate short blue bracket around a visible dark/gold elbow bearing; gap remains open.
Outward-biased broad shell with slanted upper opening, flat/radiused face bands and a narrower wrist mouth. Preserve its asymmetric contour.
Small marker straddles the lower diagonal cuff region; does not define a raised antenna.
Outer palm shell is angled and separated from the thumb shell by dark mechanics.
Thumb opposes the three long fingers. Its dark tip points inward/down and is not a fourth straight picket.
Three long fingers have ivory proximal shields and segmented dark bent tips; dark palm knuckles remain visible. Envelope does not supply unseen tendon or hinge axes.
Small sloped connector bridges chest and hip joint. Pair remains separate, revealing multiple dark bearing layers.
Narrow tapered front cartridge, inset dark slot near bottom. Side hip mechanics remain dark and exposed.
Broad curved faceted thigh with narrow hip attachment and a large asymmetric lower yellow insert. Pair splays outward toward knees.
Yellow polygon breaks out of the thigh and wraps the knee. Bottom notch exposes a separate small dark pad.
A distinct forward face, broad upper opening and clipped lower corner; black side mechanics are visible on both sides.
Short slanted bridge between the second and ankle bearing groups, with two parallel cheek sides and open dark hinge gap.
Broad low toe cover, bevel breaks and an overlapping upper step; not a single uniform wedge.
Visible ivory side rail is separate from central toe and black heel block.
Dark low front bumper/sole, visibly clipped lower corners.
Rear dark block remains higher than the fore sole; it is not a small flat black stripe.

profile_relationships.constraint: Front visual template uses H=2.65 m / 516 px; W approximately 375 px * scale = 1.926 m. The header W=2.587 m remains pending.
profile_relationships.scope: visual model scale only, not physical survey

profile_relationships.constraint: No separate head/neck. Ivory crown and chest shield form one continuous envelope, with shallow planar/curved transitions.

Keep crown inset, approximately 120 px frontal break and long tapered main shield as separate face regions within one envelope. Broad front face has shallow curvature, distinct flank facets and radiused perimeter.
Loft swept ribbon profiles with corner/ridge continuity. Keep dark recessed shoulder bearing gap and rear/top width. Do not fit a generic ellipsoid.

Maintain slanted elbow opening, outward broad face, narrower wrist mouth and separate lower cuff line. Loft several asymmetrical cross-sections with facet ridges; an axial cone/capsule is insufficient.

Front legs spread toward knee/fold and wide low feet. Side appearance is upper forward shield, rearward middle segment, short forward ankle bridge. Preserve three discrete stages and exposed bearing groups. Exact physical knee axis is occluded and must stay unresolved here.

Visible rings consist of deep dark outer housing, thin recessed gold band, dark face, inner bearing/bridge. Side caps and transverse bridge have different diameters/lengths. Do not replace all joints with identical flat black discs.

Each visible hand has three long segmented curled fingers and one opposing thumb. Ivory proximal guards, dark exposed knuckles/tips and angled outer palm shell are independent surfaces. No unseen hinge count or tendon route is specified.

Broad low foot has ivory sloping upper toe, an overlapping low perimeter rail, dark front sole and a tall clipped rear heel block. Preserve depth layering and proportions; do not use a single box/wedge.
The back ends high and relatively wide above waist; it does not duplicate the long pointed front shield. Blue service hatch is thin rectangular/clipped with tab, recessed handle and screws.

Most major body features are approximately bilateral. Reflection about the measured centerline may seed geometry, but manually compare both original halves before acceptance; reflected samples are not additional observed landmarks.

layout_b_comparison.comparison_method: Actually viewed source JPG and actual B four-view render; qualitative geometry differences only, no invented fidelity percentage.

core_items.observed_difference: B turns crown and main shield into one broad flat/simple surface, losing the crown seam, shallow intermediate ridge and long narrow tip.
core_items.minimum_geometry_repair: Use front/side/top contours to make a continuous multi-face shield with crown inset, flank facets and the small bottom bevel; preserve the original envelope.

core_items.observed_difference: B blue shoulders are rounded pods; source has swept faceted ribbon shells that taper inward and wrap the crown-side dark bearings.
core_items.minimum_geometry_repair: Rebuild the shoulder sweep with independent contour loft sections and deliberate ridges, retaining recessed black mechanism space.

core_items.observed_difference: B ivory guards are simple tapered tubes and blue outer caps lack the source overlap/cutout.
core_items.minimum_geometry_repair: Separate ivory bearing guard, outer blue open cap and lower ivory angled guard. Match visible arcs/openings before choosing any internal module.

core_items.observed_difference: B vents read as protruding orange square boxes, source vents have rounded gold inset bezels, dark slats and ivory side mounts integrated into chest cheeks.
core_items.minimum_geometry_repair: Form shallow pocket/rounded bezel/slats within the matching chest-side surfaces; avoid moving the body contour outward to accommodate a box.

core_items.observed_difference: B leaves broad simplified side blue strips/voids; source cheeks have separate diagonal facets and narrow toward the white tip.
core_items.minimum_geometry_repair: Use the visible color boundary profiles and preserve the dark recessed mechanical layer between shoulder, vent and hip.

core_items.observed_difference: B forearms are near-vertical symmetric balloon/cone shapes, source is slanted asymmetric armor with a wide outer face, slanted upper opening and narrower lower mouth.
core_items.minimum_geometry_repair: Loft front/side/top asymmetrical contour sections, add face-ridge/cuff separation and expose correct dark openings.

core_items.observed_difference: B wrists are single plain gaps/rings, source has nested dark knuckle/bearing pieces and a sloped ivory palm shell.
core_items.minimum_geometry_repair: Build independent wrist mouth, exposed bearing/knuckle layer and separate ivory palm shell; do not hide the source gap.

core_items.observed_difference: B hands have nearly equal straight pickets and block palms; source has three bent segmented fingers, ivory proximal shields and an opposing thumb with angled guards.
core_items.minimum_geometry_repair: Rebuild fingers around observed curved envelopes with distinct proximal/dark distal pieces and separate thumb; keep gaps visible.

core_items.observed_difference: B hip area uses oversized plain black transverse components and a simple hanging center block.
core_items.minimum_geometry_repair: Restore paired sloped ivory connectors, nested dark side bearings and tapered yellow/ivory front/rear cartridges; do not thicken the waist to fit prior drives.

core_items.observed_difference: B thighs are largely round pods with simplified yellow blocks. Source thighs have a narrow hip entry, broad curved/faceted lower volume and a polygonal overlap.
core_items.minimum_geometry_repair: Match blue/yellow outline and the diagonal highlight crease using multiple controlled face bands and the original front leg splay.

core_items.observed_difference: B yellow knee panels are simple rectangles/extrusions, source has a clipped polygon that wraps the dark transverse bearing and leaves a small dark bottom pad.
core_items.minimum_geometry_repair: Use the traced yellow outline and independent black pad/bearing bridge; preserve the small lower notch and side facets.

core_items.observed_difference: B lower legs are generic shells and short straight connectors, source has three distinct swept stages with rearward/forward changes and layered exposed mechanisms.
core_items.minimum_geometry_repair: Fit the front and side appearance profiles per stage and restore separate bearing cheek caps/bridges. Keep the occluded exact knee axis unresolved until joint design.

core_items.observed_difference: B repeats identical flat black circles with bright flat border. Source uses nested offset housings, thin gold band, dark rounded caps and connecting collars of varying widths.
core_items.minimum_geometry_repair: Use per-joint observed cap size, band inset and stepped coaxial geometry; avoid one universal joint primitive.

core_items.observed_difference: B feet are smooth flat wedges/plates, source uses stepped ivory toe armor, separate side rails, dark clipped front bumper and tall rear heel block.
core_items.minimum_geometry_repair: Rebuild overlapping toe/rail/bumper/heel parts from front/left/rear contours with shallow bevels and source-compatible silhouette.

core_items.observed_difference: B top looks split into two broad separate ivory masses, and back/hatch/pelvis are over-simplified. Source top is a continuous wedge envelope; back has an inset crown and thin clipped service hatch with tab/handle/fasteners.
core_items.minimum_geometry_repair: Integrate the continuous crown/front shield and deliberately distinct rear enclosure; restore visible service details and pelvis subdivisions without inventing hidden geometry.

acceptance_limits.unseen_surfaces: Not defined by this reference. Any inferred reconstruction must be labelled and kept separate from directly observed reference points.
